title: AI Nutrition Label
description: Machine-readable, agent-actionable AI Nutrition Label. A direct, standardized port of the 'AI Nutrition Labels for Everyone' framework (medium.com/@aashkafirst) -- same categories (Model Identity, Functional Capabilities, Performance Value, Safety Value, Bias Value, Environmental Impact, Privacy Seal, Limitations) and the same PV/SV/BV formulae, made queryable by AI agents instead of only readable by humans. Deliberately domain-agnostic: nothing here assumes healthcare, finance, etc. Domain-specific overlays (e.g. child-safety data for an education deployment) can be attached later via the optional `extensions` object without changing this core schema. v0.3-draft adds real AI Energy Score benchmark data/methodology to environmental_impact.

estimated_fields.description: Dot-path list of fields in this label whose values are placeholder/estimated (no public source exists) rather than sourced from an official model/system card. Lets a consuming agent programmatically discount or flag low-confidence fields instead of silently trusting them. e.g. ['safety_and_bias.components.toxic_prompt_refusal_rate_pct', 'environmental_impact.estimated_co2e_grams_per_1k_queries']

parameter_count.description: e.g. '8B', '54.5B (MoE)', or 'undisclosed' -- many providers do not publish this.

modality_support.description: Which input/output modalities the model handles.

context_window_tokens.description: Memory capacity; null/omit for non-token-based models (e.g. pure image generators).

supported_languages.description: Languages the model has documented support/evaluation for. Empty/omitted for non-language modalities.

components.description: Each 0-100. For non-LLM modalities these are adapted proxies (see benchmark_sources) rather than literal MMLU/HumanEval scores.

performance_value.description: PV = (general_reasoning + coding + math + common_sense_reasoning) / 4. Derived by agent/scoring.py, not hand-entered.

benchmark_sources.description: Which real benchmark (or proxy methodology) backs each component, e.g. { 'general_reasoning': 'MMLU', 'coding': 'HumanEval' }.

safety_applicable.description: False for modalities where refusal-rate-style conversational safety metrics don't apply (e.g. a pure translation model). When false, safety_value is null and safety_components are placeholder zeros, not real measurements.

safety_value.description: SV = (Rtoxic + (100-Rnontoxic) + (100-IR)) / 3. Derived by agent/scoring.py. Null when safety_applicable is false.

bias_benchmark_scores.description: 0-1 scale, higher = less biased, per cultural/demographic context, e.g. { 'BBQ_english': 0.81, 'BBQ_korean': 0.62, 'BBQ_indian': 0.58 }. Empty object if no such evaluation exists for this model -- this is common; the source article notes evaluations 'don't exist' for many models across most benchmark contexts.

bias_value.description: BV = weighted average of bias_benchmark_scores. Null if bias_benchmark_scores is empty.

bias_formula.const: BV = weighted average of bias benchmark values (0-1 scale)

carbon_footprint_grade.description: A+ = minimal footprint, D = very high. Derived from estimated_co2e_grams_per_1k_queries via agent/scoring.py threshold table, itself calibrated against real published reference points (see agent/scoring.py docstring).

energy_rating_stars.description: 5 = extremely efficient, 1 = high energy consumption. See ai_energy_score below for whether this figure is grounded in a real measurement.

green_energy_seal_pct.description: % of compute run on renewable energy, per provider's (or its primary cloud infrastructure partner's) published sustainability commitment where available.

methodology_note.description: Explains what's real (e.g. provider's public sustainability commitments, or a directly-published per-query energy/water figure) vs. estimated (derived via a documented conversion or analogy -- see agent/scoring.py).

ai_energy_score.description: Ties this label's energy figures to the real AI Energy Score benchmark (Hugging Face / Salesforce / Carnegie Mellon; https://huggingface.co/spaces/AIEnergyScore/Leaderboard), which measures GPU energy in Wh per 1,000 queries across 10 tasks via standardized hardware, with a 1-5 star rating per task (bottom/top 20% of measured GPU energy for that task).

on_official_leaderboard.description: True only if this exact model/version is directly measured on the official leaderboard. False for every label in this registry -- see disclosure.

closest_task_category.description: Which of the benchmark's 10 official task categories is the closest analogue for this model (e.g. 'text_generation', 'image_generation'), or 'not_covered' if none apply (e.g. machine translation isn't one of the 10 tasks).

model_class.description: Only meaningful for closest_task_category = 'text_generation'. Class A = single consumer GPU (<=20B params), B = single cloud GPU (<=66B params), C = multiple cloud GPUs (>66B params).

comparable_real_models.description: Real rows pulled directly from the official leaderboard's published data, included as reference points since this model itself isn't measured there.

disclosure.description: Plain-language statement of what is and isn't real here -- e.g. whether the underlying energy_wh figure is a provider-published number (real) or an estimate, and that the star rating is our own extrapolation using the benchmark's methodology, not an official measurement.

privacy_seal.description: Gold = your data isn't used for training (or model is self-hostable with no forced telemetry).

not_recommended_for.description: Use cases the provider explicitly discourages without qualified human review, e.g. 'medical diagnosis', 'legal advice', 'financial advice'.

extensions.description: Deliberately unspecified in v0.2-draft. Reserved for future domain-specific overlays (e.g. a healthcare consumer might attach clinical-safety-threshold or population-representativeness data here) without requiring changes to the core standardized schema above. Not required, and empty/omitted by default.
